svg.title: 60c Add user
svg.text: Each user belongs to a department and an office and has one role. Accounts in use are deactivated, never deleted.
They sign in at the same door as everyone else.

g.text: An IDIU address · she signs in with it
Decides the menus and the approval steps: Dashboard, Requisitions, Deliveries
At least 10 characters. She must change it at first sign-in.

svg.text: Email the sign-in details to Sarah
Can be appointed to evaluation committees
Recorded in the audit trail · deactivated, never deleted
